2110068691807461447.en_summary: Fish Audio just introduced Drama 3 which is an open AI voice model that lets developers edit speech like text and control how individual words sound. You’re going to see more examples like this as AI voice becomes easier to build and advantage shifts toward companies like $META that already reach billions of users through their apps and devices.

2110061698803761557.en_summary: $QCOM just won a jury verdict in its licensing dispute with $ARM with a 5-year royalty clause potentially worth ~$1.5B still awaiting judge’s decision. Qualcomm is one of Arm’s biggest customers so the outcome could shape future licensing agreements as Arm expands beyond chip designs into selling its own silicon.
2110061698803761557.zh_summary: $QCOM剛剛在與$ARM的許可爭議中贏得陪審團裁決，5年特許權使用費條款潛在價值約15億美元，仍待法官決定。Qualcomm是Arm最大客戶之一，因此結果可能影響未來許可協議，因為Arm正從芯片設計擴展到銷售自己的硅片。
2110061698803761557.ko_summary: $QCOM이 $ARM과의 라이선스 분쟁에서 배심원 판결을 방금 이겼으며, 약 15억 달러 가치의 5년 로열티 조항은 아직 판사 결정을 기다리고 있습니다. Qualcomm은 Arm의 최대 고객 중 하나이므로 결과가 Arm이 칩 설계를 넘어 자체 실리콘 판매로 확장함에 따라 미래 라이선스 계약을 형성할 수 있습니다.

ticker_notes.QCOM: 贏得陪審團裁決，潛在~ $1.5B特許權使用費
ticker_notes.ARM: 許可爭議敗訴，可能影響未來協議
